name: MORUM Rug flatwoven, in/outdoor, beige, 5 ' 3 "x7 ' 7 "

dimensions.raw: Length: 7 ' 7 "; Width: 5 ' 3 "; Area: 39.61 sq feet; Thickness: ¼ "
dimensions.source: IKEA Measurements section, read in Chrome 2026-10-22; feet and inches to inches (5'3" = 63, 7'7" = 91): Width is w, Length is d, Thickness is h (as the other rugs in the catalog)

notes: Flags: none. Fit: 63 x 91" in the 128 x 119" dining room, its length along the table: under the ALHULT (31.5 x 47.25") it runs 15.75" past each long side and 21.9" past each end, so the back legs of a fully pulled-out chair (SANDSBERG, 18.5" deep) land about 3" off its long edges; the brief's 'about 5'7" x 7'10"' is 4" wider and 3" longer. Washable by hand, not machine washable (so no washable tag): 100 % polypropylene with a synthetic rubber backing; care 'Use a mild detergent, brush with a soft brush and rinse thoroughly with water. Let the rug dry completely before use. Hand wash warm water.' Page: 'Ideal in your living room or under your dining table since the flat-woven surface makes it easy to pull out the chairs and vacuum'; in/outdoor. Good to know: 'You will need 1 STOPP FILT rug underlay with anti-slip (5'5"x7'9") for this rug' (ikea-90132261, for the tile floor). Other sizes: 6'7"x9'10" $149.99 (too deep for the 119" room once the table is centered), 7'10"x10' $199.99. Not badged; 4.6 stars (2,322). In stock in IKEA Long Island, NY on 2026-10-22. rooms: dining-room, from the staging brief.
